PDF Extinction-based Shading and Illumination in GPU Volume Ray-Casting - UZH
Shadow maps are dependent on light position and TF with the evaluation typically done for a single light only. Half-angle slicing [13, 14, 36] is able to produce more realistic soft shadows with very small additional storage requirements, but also with the limitation of a single directional light source support.
